page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server powered by KVM virtualization on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 128 GB of system memory, providing a balanced memory allocation of 4 GB per virtual CPU core. Accelerating parallel workloads, the server is equipped with two NVIDIA P4 GPUs offering a combined total of 16 GB video RAM.

The ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge configuration includes no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system and application volumes. Network performance features a baseline bandwidth allocation of 6 Gbps. The provision of dual NVIDIA P4 accelerators targets parallelized computing tasks, machine learning inference, and media processing.

By combining 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128 GB RAM with energy-efficient NVIDIA P4 GPUs, this instance provides a practical resource ratio for mid-tier inference and compute-heavy tasks. The lack of built-in local storage trades local drive performance for flexibility in cloud storage attachment. Recommended workload fits include AI inference deployment, video transcoding, real-time image rendering, and parallel scientific calculations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance built on KVM virtualization using the x86_64 architecture.
